svg.title: berth: the VRAM leasing service for every GPU you run
svg.desc: A llama harbor master on a night pier holds a lit padlock lantern moored to a dock board of GPU berths. On gpu0 llama-swap hands the card to strata at a request boundary, comfyui waits for its job boundary on gpu1, and a game holds gpu2. Zero collisions.

g.text: the VRAM leasing service for every GPU you run
